title: Gluing the affine embedded-point submodules
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $X=\bigcup_iU_i$ be an affine open cover, put $A_i=\mathcal O_X(U_i)$ and $M_i=\mathcal F(U_i)$, and choose a finitely generated $A_i$-submodule $N_i\subseteq M_i$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] for every $i$. For $f\in A_i$ write $D(f)=\{x\in U_i: f(x)\neq0\}$ and $N_i[f]\subseteq\mathcal F(D(f))$ for the image of $(N_i)_f$ under the canonical identification $(M_i)_f\cong\mathcal F(D(f))$. Assume that whenever an open $V\subseteq U_i\cap U_j$ is principal in both, $V=D(f)$ with $f\in A_i$ and $V=D(g)$ with $g\in A_j$, one has $N_i[f]=N_j[g]$ in $\mathcal F(V)$. Then there is a unique coherent subsheaf $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal F$ with $\mathcal K(D(f))=N_i[f]$ for all $i$ and $f\in A_i$ (in particular $\mathcal K(U_i)=N_i$), and the quotient sheaf $\mathcal F/\mathcal K$ satisfies $(\mathcal F/\mathcal K)(U_i)=M_i/N_i$, i.e. the affine quotients glue to $\mathcal F/\mathcal K$.

proof.text: Construct each local subsheaf as the abelian image of the finite free map into F restricted to U_i induced by a finite spanning set of N_i. This is a real categorical construction, with no data taken from an unproved existence statement. The free module and image are quasi-coherent. Surjectivity of the image factorization on affine sections and the finite free coordinate formula show that its section image on U_i is exactly N_i. By quasi-coherence this image construction is the usual affine sheaf of N_i, so on principal opens its image is the localized submodule. The Lean helper affine_local_realization proves the mono, quasi-coherence and section-range clauses.

For each open W in an overlap and x in W, first choose a principal open of U_i inside W. Apply the common-principal-open lemma to this affine principal open and U_j, then rewrite the resulting nested principal open as a principal open of U_i. Thus the opens principal in both charts form a basis of the overlap. Section-range equality on that basis makes each inclusion followed by the other cokernel projection zero there. Sheaf separation for the cokernel makes this composite zero on every open. Each mono is the kernel of its cokernel, so Abelian.monoLift factors the two inclusions through one another, identifying their subobjects. The resulting isomorphisms commute with inclusions, and their cocycle identity follows by cancellation of a monomorphism. Glue sheaves and inclusions by the module-sheaf gluing theorem. Local injectivity and sheaf separation show that the global map is a monomorphism.

The glued module is quasi-coherent because it is so after restriction to the covering opens. Pass to the associated subobject of F. On a locally Noetherian scheme, a quasi-coherent submodule of a coherent module is coherent; apply the existing coherent-submodule criterion.

Local range equality and affine_local_realization identify the global inclusion image on U_i with N_i. Apply the affine cokernel formula to identify its cokernel sections with Gamma(F,U_i)/N_i. Finally any other candidate has the same section ranges on the affine covering; module_subobject_eq_on_cover identifies it with the constructed subobject.

theorem existsUnique_coherent_submodule_of_affine_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (I : Type u) (U : I → X.Opens) (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (N : ∀ i, Submodule Γ(X, U i) Γ(F, U i))
    (hN : ∀ i, Module.Finite Γ(X, U i) (N i))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i j : I) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
      (∃ (f : Γ(X, U i)) (g : Γ(X, U j)),
        W = X.basicOpen f ∧ W = X.basicOpen g) →
      Set.range ((affineSectionSubmodule X F (U i) (N i) (hN i)).2.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi)))) =
      Set.range ((affineSectionSubmodule X F (U j) (N j) (hN j)).2.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj))))) :
    ∃! K : Subobject F,
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (K : X.Modules) ∧
      (∀ (i : I) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i),
        Set.range (K.arrow.app W) =
          Set.range ((affineSectionSubmodule X F (U i) (N i) (hN i)).2.val.app
            (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))))) ∧
      (∀ i, LinearMap.range (K.arrow.val.app (op (U i))).hom = N i) ∧
      (∀ i, Nonempty (Γ((cokernel K.arrow : X.Modules), U i) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U i)]
        (Γ(F, U i) ⧸ N i)))
